verdict.rationale: Cekura documents one framework-level tracing integration: enhanced observability for LiveKit agents via the Cekura SDK (cekura-docs-15, cekura-docs-40). Its other integrations are voice-platform connectors (Retell pulling call data, a post-call send-calls API), not framework instrumentation, and none of the named frameworks appear. missing for 10: LangChain integration, OpenAI SDK integration, Vercel AI SDK integration, broader framework-instrumentation coverage beyond LiveKit, independent corroboration.
